description.value: SuperValu Gibsons is a 100% independent, family-owned supermarket that has served the Sunshine Coast for over 70 years, located in Sunnycrest Mall in Upper Gibsons. It stands out for an unusually broad specialty-food offering—organic, plant-based, international, and natural products—alongside what it claims is the most extensive cheese selection on the Sunshine Coast. The in-store deli and scratch bakery make it a solid resupply point for touring cyclists passing through Gibsons.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at coastgrocery.ca/gibsons confirms SuperValu Gibsons is an active, full-service independent supermarket at 900 Gibsons Way, Sunnycrest Mall, Gibsons, with phone 604-886-2424. Basic groceries are clearly confirmed by the extensive product description; hot food is confirmed by the deli section listing 'hot BBQ chicken,' 'homemade shepherd's pie,' and 'daily lunch & dinner specials that are ready-to-go.' No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in the OSM tags, so those remain null.
